title: Manipulability Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Kinematics
description: Bend the elbow of a two-link arm and watch its manipulability, its condition number and the ellipse at its tip. Then calculate the manipulability in six problems with the formula w = l1 × l2 × |sin(bend)|. Used in Chapter 19.

educational.topic: Manipulability of a two-link arm and the manipulability ellipse
learningObjectives: Calculate the manipulability of a two-link arm from its link lengths and elbow bend, and compare two poses, to within 0.1 of the unit shown, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Watch a measure and its picture change with one angle, then use the formula on new numbers with an immediate check
keyQuestions: Why does the shoulder angle not change the manipulability?
How many times smaller is w at a bend of 5 degrees than at 90 degrees?
commonMisconceptions: Manipulability depends on the shoulder angle
A straight arm is the most manipulable
Halving the bend halves the manipulability
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed answers, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery
